cases.name: NER failure increments retry count then reaches FAILED at NER_MAX_RETRIES
late-chunking flag ON: embedWithSpans returns null (content exceeds the raised single-pass limit) — folds INLINE into resumable document windows, still ONE bundled write for the parent
all three encoders in one cycle: an embedding failure for a doc does not clobber that same doc's successful SPLADE/NER writes, and everything flushes in one batched write
tempdoc 717 (P1): a persistently blank-content chunk reaches FAILED at max retries and stops being reselected
blank-content escalation: writes every cycle, but progressed() is false until the terminal FAILED step (tempdoc 798 F2)
tempdoc 717 (P1): a blank-content chunk is escalated (retry), never marked COMPLETED without a vector
chunk-SPLADE flag ON, parent-lane pickup (splade-status query): a splade-PENDING chunk doc is encoded from its reconstructed parent slice and completed in ONE bundled write
late-chunking flag OFF: strict no-op vs today — combined pass embeds a chunked parent via the ordinary windowed batch, embedWithSpans is never called
chunk-SPLADE flag OFF: a chunk's splade_status must not consume a batch slot the parent backlog needs — the splade-pending selection excludes chunk documents
mixed batch: one doc succeeds and one fails, each gets the right per-doc update, in a single batched write
embedding failure increments retry count on the batched write (no status change)
embedding success path is unchanged: vector written, retry count reset to 0
SPLADE failure increments retry count then reaches FAILED at SPLADE_MAX_RETRIES
chunk-SPLADE flag ON: a splade-FAILED chunk doc is NOT resurrected — dense enrichment proceeds, sparse is left alone (poison-pill respected)
late-chunking flag ON: GPU arena-OOM (wrapped RuntimeException) on the single-pass call — folds INLINE into the windowed batch same as the over-limit null case

late-chunking flag ON: embedWithSpans throws a non-arena-OOM exception — PARENT ONLY gets retry-count escalation (tempdoc 700 parity), not marked complete; SPLADE still succeeds independently in the same bundled write
chunk-SPLADE flag OFF: a BLANK-content chunk escalates only the stage that was attempted — its chunk embedding, never the SPLADE stage the flag turned off
late-chunking flag ON: a chunkless parent (no PARENT_DOC_ID-matching chunk docs) uses the normal windowed batch — embedWithSpans is never called for it
chunk-SPLADE flag OFF: repeating the cycle past SPLADE_MAX_RETRIES never drives a chunk to terminal FAILED and never reports progress — the non-converging loop of tempdoc 931
chunk-SPLADE flag OFF (default): a splade-PENDING chunk doc is not selected, not enrolled and not rewritten — the pass converges on the first cycle (tempdoc 931)
absent, FAILED, and COMPLETED_EMPTY SPLADE states are never falsely encoded
embedding failure reaches FAILED at EMBEDDING_MAX_RETRIES and stops being re-selected

an encode that produced no materialisable weight writes COMPLETED_EMPTY, not COMPLETED — COMPLETED would be a data-less claim the write-time contract rejects and the RMW reset lane would bounce back to PENDING forever

late-chunking flag ON: chunked parent's VECTOR comes from embedWithSpans (whole doc, empty span array) and lands in the SAME per-doc update map as its SPLADE/NER results — one bundled write, embedDocumentBatch never called for this doc's content
a chunk doc pulled in by the splade-status query must not have EMBEDDING_STATUS or NER_STATUS manufactured for it — an ABSENT status means the stage does not apply
R6: ordinary remainder retains main's fallback cancellation stop accounting
P13: unclassified short parents keep their single-pass vector on a later cycle
R4: successful individual fallbacks allow the parent turn
P4/P10: non-systemic priority batch failures retain individual retry accounting
R5: later priority fallback cancellation preserves success and reports abort
R9: normal turn order and embedding budget stay unchanged
the chunk-only tail completes on ordinary dense units
P4: real window failures still consume one retry and reach FAILED
an embed-only backlog keeps the whole cycle — the reservation does not misfire
in-flight partials are tracked and cleared
CONTROL: without cross-cycle window progress the same documents never complete
hard preemption after a late-chunk probe still prevents the fallback window
an out-of-order slice is rejected rather than double-counted
windows accumulated across cycles pool to the same unit vector
a long document resumes at its next window across cycles and the work-set drains
changed content invalidates a partial instead of blending two revisions
